title: ارسال پرونده ایران به شورای امنیت چه معنایی دارد؟

title: BRICS declaration aligns with Iran’s key positions: Gharibabadi

body: Tehran, IRNA – The BRICS countries have voiced serious concern over the rise of unilateral tariffs and non-tariff measures that distort trade and violate World Trade Organization rules, while condemning unilateral coercive measures that violate international law.

title: Iran president and Abu Dhabi crown prince meet in New Delhi

title: Terrorist team dismantled in southeastern Iran
body: Tehran, IRNA – The Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) Ground Force Quds Headquarters has announced the elimination of a terrorist team in the southeastern Iranian province of Sistan and Baluchestan.

title: Pezeshkian warns against return of unilateralism, urges BRICS to defend multilateralism
body: Tehran, IRNA – Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian, addressing the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi, has once again called for stronger multilateralism and global justice, warning that the return of unilateralism would weaken the very foundation of global governance.

title: IRGC, Army chiefs meet, emphasize strong defense against enemies
